source: A fallen follower returns after 20 s: Icy Veins follower guide 'When slain, the follower revives after a 20 second timer', Warcraft Tavern 'automatically revive after 20 seconds' (docs/research/followers-web-sources.md R1a section 8, which leans on these two over the older 30 s)

A follower leaves at once when a second player joins (the hire is kept) and returns when the party ends: the designer's dev look at F1, q-1021-43, 'if they party the follower goes back to the hub', in place of the 20 s of Diablo Wiki Followers 'the follower automatically leaves in 20 seconds' (R1a section 8). The only rule that may be zero.
A follower left behind jumps to its player after 5 s: Diablo Wiki Followers 'the follower will teleport to them in 5 seconds' (R1a section 8)

How far behind counts as left behind. D3 gives no distance; this is the stock pet's own rule, the follow generator teleports a pet that is stuck beyond 20 yd (azerothcore-wotlk src/server/game/Movement/MovementGenerators/TargetedMovementGenerator.cpp, 'Teleport if stuck and too far away')
